description.value: Carmelo's is a long-established Italian pizzeria and ristorante in the Ambleside neighbourhood of West Vancouver, open for over 20 years and known for wood-fired thin-crust pizza and house-made pastas blending Italian and BC West Coast flavours. It sits a five-minute walk from Ambleside beach and the seawall, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists touring the North Shore. The menu ranges from classic pasta and pizza to fresh local seafood, all prepared in a comfortable, neighbourhood dining room.

address.value: 1448 Marine Drive, West Vancouver, BC V7T 1B7
